title: Word Formation: Czasowniki i przyslowki (krok 1: koncowki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazde zdanie jednym wyrazem, przeksztalcajac wyraz podany wielkimi literami obok luki. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna. W tym cwiczeniu wystarczy dodac koncowke - zaden wyraz nie potrzebuje przedrostka.

items.sentence: Could you __________ the rules of cricket for me?
The school plans to __________ all of its computer rooms.
Regular exercise will __________ your heart and your legs.
The council wants to __________ the road outside the school.
__________, nobody was hurt when the roof came down.
She read the instructions __________ before starting.
The temperature dropped __________ during the night.
Scientists are trying to __________ the water supply.
